display_name: SegFormer MiT-B0 V9 Semantic Core (BANDA and JNPA PAN 2.5m)
author: Vansh Arora
architecture: SegFormer MiT-B0 V9, one-channel five-class semantic head
metrics_status: Not independently measured for this exported raw tensor interface
metric_scope: Do not substitute full-pipeline development metrics, weak-label agreement or road-only scores. Null means unavailable, not zero.
class_weights_scope: Neutral inference/ensemble weights; not a claim about static training loss weights

preprocessing.normalization_scope: Whole scene once before tiling; reuse scene-wide limits when streaming
preprocessing.nodata_policy: All-zero or nonfinite input is excluded from normalization; host must preserve raster masks as Unknown 255
preprocessing.input_range: raw DN; adapter returns float32 in [0,1]; do not apply ImageNet normalization

checkpoint_format: tensor-only state_dict; original FP32; lossless ZIP DEFLATE

original_pipeline.distinction: Texture teacher/student cascade, road geometry filtering and Unknown rejection remain separate; raw SegFormer is not the full hybrid

limitations: Research model, not a validated navigation or survey product
Tensor interface has five logits; apply no-data/cloud/uncertainty masks outside the network
Same GSD does not guarantee accuracy at unseen locations
Export does not retrain the model or improve accuracy
